pitfall_alerts.risk: A bool flag may gate a conditional output. Allocating that output as {0}/zero-sized on flag=False can trip kernel tiling CheckOutShape (rank mismatch, err 561002). The flag usually controls WHETHER valid data is written, NOT whether/what-shape the tensor is allocated.
pitfall_alerts.action: BEFORE writing C++ and meta for any flag-gated output: read the case. Decide allocation shape from THIS operator's aclnn header (required/optional) + .md param-table dims — never copy a sibling's {0}. C++ and meta must use the identical shape rule.
